title: Schedule of Home-Sale Contingency Terms — Home Purchase Agreement
content:
**Schedule C. Home-sale contingency terms by collection.** A Home Purchase Agreement may be made contingent on the sale of the buyer's current home only in a collection where the schedule shows the contingency as allowed. Where it is allowed, the schedule fixes the extra earnest money due at signing, the calendar days from the contract date to the contingency deadline, and the calendar days after a kick-out notice within which the buyer must release the contingency.

| Collection | Home-sale contingency allowed | Extra earnest money at signing (USD) | Days from contract date to contingency deadline | Days to release after a kick-out notice |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pathway Collection | No | 0.00 | 0 | 0 |
| Meadow Collection | Yes | 2500.00 | 45 | 3 |
| Heritage Collection | Yes | 5000.00 | 45 | 3 |
| Crestview Collection | Yes | 7500.00 | 60 | 3 |
| Summit Collection | Yes | 10000.00 | 60 | 3 |
| Reserve Collection | Yes | 15000.00 | 90 | 5 |

**Note to Schedule C.** The Pathway Collection does not allow a home-sale contingency, and its zero figures carry no deadline or response period. In every other collection a contingency may be written, and the Reserve Collection carries the longest contingency period (90 days) and the longest kick-out response period (5 days).

**Illustration (hypothetical).** On a hypothetical Crestview Collection agreement written with a home-sale contingency, the schedule reads an extra 7500.00 of earnest money at signing, a contingency deadline 60 calendar days after the contract date, and 3 calendar days to release the contingency after a kick-out notice.
